reading.body:
DISKUS Polska is a facility tagged as a data center in Wieliczka, Poland, near Kraków, but cannot be verified as an operating data center serving AI workloads or any confirmed commercial function.

The entry rests on a single OpenStreetMap tag and a plausible company name. "Diskus" suggests computing or storage, and Kraków hosts genuine technology hubs, which makes a small Polish IT business in the area credible in principle. The website domain exists but was not accessed during research. No operator identity, capacity figures, power supply details, or confirmed business registration could be established.

This illustrates a hard limit of infrastructure mapping: many facilities tagged in crowdsourced databases lack the operational metadata required to assess their role in AI compute supply. Without confirmation of operator, power consumption, uptime commitment, or customer base, DISKUS Polska cannot be counted as active data center capacity. It signals a research gap rather than a resource constraint.
